cards.subject: A green valley
lines: Two hundred and thirty years ago Thaurissan summoned Ragnaros here during the War of the Three Hammers.
The blast raised Blackrock Mountain and burned the valley around it in the same instant. The zone and the mountain you are staring at were made by one mistake.

cards.subject: Stonewrought Pass
lines: The famous locked door is not in this zone. It is the tunnel out of Loch Modan's Valley of Kings, and in here it is barred at each end.
A rogue with two hundred and twenty-five lockpicking opens it.
So does dying at the gate and walking through as a ghost.

cards.subject: The key required you to already be in
lines: The Alliance chain starts by killing Margol the Rager — who lives inside Searing Gorge.
To earn the key to the gate you first had to take the long way round through the Badlands and get in without it.
And then Ironforge had to authenticate the horn before anyone would believe you.

cards.subject: The Horde never needed a key
lines: No Horde version of the chain exists. They come in by a back road the orcs paved through the Badlands.
Alliance players used the same road for years rather than run the quest.

cards.subject: Thorium Point
lines: "Searing Gorge has a new quest hub for both Alliance and Horde players called Thorium Point."
Before that, this zone had no hub, no flight path and no forge at all.
You came in through a locked door to a place with nowhere to stand.

cards.subject: Two flight masters, feet apart
lines: Lanie Reed flies the Alliance and Grisha flies the Horde, off the same rock.
No inn, no bank, no mailbox, no auction house.
A forge, an anvil, and two enemies' flight paths.

cards.subject: The Thorium Brotherhood
cards.tag: They escaped and did not leave
lines: Dark Iron smiths forced to mass-produce weapons for Ragnaros, who forged their own tools and got out.
Then they settled two hills away from the thing they fled.
Their formulas need components found only near Blackrock Mountain. They stayed because the metal is here.

cards.subject: The slaves will fight you
lines: Ironforge dwarves, gnolls and ogres taken by the Dark Iron and worked in the pit under the excavation machines.
"Driven mad by their masters, the grueling work, and the constant oppressive heat."
They attack anyone who interrupts the work, rescuers included.

cards.subject: Grimesilt Dig Site
cards.tag: Two of the original crew are still down there
lines: Ironforge dwarves opened this excavation. The Dark Iron took it and still hold it.
Dorius Stonetender lies injured at the bottom of the pit.
Locheed is trapped in an outhouse nearby.

cards.subject: Firewatch Ridge
cards.tag: The high ground over the Cauldron
lines: Dark Iron dwarves, their mechanical golems and giant flame spiders.
The whole ridge is an elite area and stays that way for all of this game's life — the tag was not lifted until patch 2.3.0.
In here it is still elite.

cards.subject: The Charred Oak
lines: A tree you can click on, in a zone made of ash. Its flavour text reads: "Looks a tad burnt."
It held bundles of charred oak for one level forty-four quest.
Removed from the game in 4.0.3a. It exists here and nowhere else.

cards.subject: There is a face in the terrain
lines: Stand outside the sealed cave near the Blackrock side and open your map.
The landforms read as a face, and the cave sits on its left cheek.

cards.subject: This is a front porch
lines: The mountain sits between here and the Burning Steppes, and this zone is its northern approach.
Everybody in the gorge at forty-five will be back at sixty, walking the same road.
To Blackrock Depths, and then to Molten Core.
